title: Shanghai World Financial Center
description: Looking up at the tall façade of the Shanghai World Financial Center. This mega skyscraper, 494 m tall, is currently the second tallest operational skyscraper in the world after the Taipei 101 in Taiwan. The building opened for business 28 August 2008, so it was less than a year old by the time we stopped for a visit.

title: "The Shanghai World Financial Center"
description: The Shanghai World Financial Center is a supertall skyscraper located in the Pudong district of Shanghai. It was designed by Kohn Pedersen Fox and developed by the Mori Building Company. It is a mixed-use skyscraper, consisting of offices, hotels, conference rooms, observation decks, and ground-floor shopping malls. Park Hyatt Shanghai is the tower's hotel component, comprising 174 rooms and suites occupying the 79th to the 93rd floors, which at the time of completion was the highest hotel in the world. It is now the third-highest hotel in the world after the Ritz-Carlton, Hong Kong, which occupies floors 102 to 118 of the International Commerce Centre. Canon 100D, Edited in Photoshop
